metadata.title: Related Work, Rebuilt
metadata.audience: Students and practitioners learning to use and report on AI systems
metadata.fellow: Janvi Chitroda, AI Data Engineer volunteer, Medhavy project, Humanitarians AI
metadata.source: inbox/term2-week12/term2-week12-video-content.md (Week 12); narration supplied verbatim and pre-approved by Janvi (2026-10-28)
metadata.note: Project update. Thesis: Professor Gultepe's comment that Related Work described our own system led to 12 new references, each checked against its publisher's page with a one-line 'what it shows' summary; the paper ends with 36 references, the Medhavy spelling throughout, a scripted final check, a 72-row response workbook, and the package sent to all three professors. The work is Janvi's. Only Professor Brown and Professor Gultepe may be named. The number of older citations removed is not stated. Every on-screen number appears in the Week 12 source as written.

beats.role_note: COLD OPEN LAW — Claude composer, ask lands answered. Required intro line + AI-narration disclosure.
beats.narration_text: Hi, I am Janvi and this video is about rebuilding our paper's related work section, and the final checks before sending it. This narration is an AI-generated voice; the work is mine.

props.command: My reviewer says our related work section describes our own system instead of prior work. How do I rebuild it?
output: Search the main databases for prior work
Check each paper on its publisher's page
Write one line on what each one shows

beats.role_note: Quote card 'Related Work describes your own system instead of prior work.' — Professor Gultepe.
beats.narration_text: Professor Gultepe pointed out that our related work section described our own system, instead of prior work.
beats.visual_intent: Quote card 'Related Work describes your own system instead of prior work.' — Professor Gultepe.

beats.role_note: Search chips: Google Scholar · ACL Anthology · PubMed · NeurIPS · arXiv → '12 new references'; 'publisher page ✓'.
beats.narration_text: So I searched Google Scholar, the ACL Anthology, PubMed, NeurIPS and arXiv, and found 12 new references. After finding fabricated citations earlier, I checked every one against its publisher's page. No unverified citation goes into this paper.
beats.visual_intent: Search chips: Google Scholar · ACL Anthology · PubMed · NeurIPS · arXiv → '12 new references'; 'publisher page ✓'.

show.event: each checked on its publisher's page ✓

beats.role_note: Reference cards: Remy 2023 closest prior work · Panickssery 2024 LLM self-evaluation · Ji 2023 hallucination · Feinstein & Cicchetti 1990 kappa interpretation · Wilson 1927 Wilson interval.
beats.narration_text: They include the closest prior work, on LLM-generated glossaries, plus work on LLM self-evaluation, hallucination, kappa interpretation, and the Wilson interval itself.
beats.visual_intent: Reference cards: Remy 2023 closest prior work · Panickssery 2024 LLM self-evaluation · Ji 2023 hallucination · Feinstein & Cicchetti 1990 kappa interpretation · Wilson 1927 Wilson interval.

beats.role_note: One-line 'what it shows' note per reference; counter '36 references · all checked'.
beats.narration_text: For each one, I wrote a one-line summary of what it actually shows, so CRITIQ couldn't overstate it. The paper now has 36 references, all checked.
beats.visual_intent: One-line 'what it shows' note per reference; counter '36 references · all checked'.

beats.role_note: Spelling swap card: old spelling struck → 'Medhavy' (the old spelling itself is not shown).
beats.narration_text: I also corrected the project's spelling to Medhavy throughout the paper.
beats.visual_intent: Spelling swap card: old spelling struck → 'Medhavy' (the old spelling itself is not shown).

beats.role_note: Scripted checklist ticking: 72 comments addressed · zero numbers lost · 8 items in order · references cited and present · abstract 293 words · retired values absent.
beats.narration_text: Then a scripted final check: all 72 comments addressed, no numbers lost, the eight figures and tables in order, every reference cited and present, the abstract at 293 words, and retired numbers absent.
beats.visual_intent: Scripted checklist ticking: 72 comments addressed · zero numbers lost · 8 items in order · references cited and present · abstract 293 words · retired values absent.

beats.role_note: Response workbook '72 rows: comment · change · location · status'; envelope with three attachments: paper · response workbook · data workbook.
beats.narration_text: I built a response workbook with one row per comment: what she asked, what changed, and where. Then I sent all three professors the paper, the response workbook and the data workbook.
beats.visual_intent: Response workbook '72 rows: comment · change · location · status'; envelope with three attachments: paper · response workbook · data workbook.

beats.role_note: HANDOFF LAW — suggested prompt typed in the composer.
beats.narration_text: Your turn. Before you cite a paper, write one line on what it shows, and check your sentence doesn't claim more.

props.command: Here is a paper I want to cite and my sentence. Does my sentence claim more than the paper shows?
